v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release of Markdown转换器免费版:

- Converts PDF, Word, Excel, PPT, HTML, images, audio, and other files to Markdown while preserving original document structure.
- Supports basic OCR for image text extraction.
- No additional software required; runs with uvx on Windows, macOS, or Linux.
- Suitable for personal use; batch conversion and advanced features require PRO version.
- Provides command-line usage examples, troubleshooting guidance, and outlines limitations of the free version.
